learning_outcomes.text: Able to design any experimental setup related to mechanical engineering.
Able to set up and calibrate the experimental equipment.
Able to prepare the experimental setup or use a readily available test setup.
Able to evaluate the experimental results.
Able to prepare and present a technical report containing the results of the experiment.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and explanation of how the course will progress
Teaching of programs to be used in experiments
